description: Land Title Settlement Department - Liyandeniiya, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320024 & Other Declarations
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
